messages.ko:
나왔어!!
오늘 이렇게 서울콘까지 마무리를 지었는데..
기분이 묘하다
투어 간다고 들었을때
놀라고 기쁜 마음에 설레하던게
엊그제같은데
벌써 미국 캐나다 방콕은 다 다녀왔고
서울까지 끝이라니
시간 무서울정도로 빠르다
난 모든 무대에 진심이였고
오늘또한 최선을 다해서
조그만한 실수들은 마음에 너무 품지않고
더나은 나를 만들려고!
오늘 콘서트 봐준 모든 웨이브 너무 고맙고
투어할수있게 만들어준건 다 모든 웨이브 덕분이야
나한테 이런 소중한 경험 할수있게해줘서 너무 고마워
원래 잘 눈물이 나지않는내가
오늘 마지막 소감얘기하는데 눈물이 나려고 하더라
몇마디만 더했으면 울뻔했는데
주빈이로 넘어가서 다행히 울지 않았어 ㅎㅎ
잠을 많이 못잤는지
얼굴이 부어서 안빠지는거야!!!
최선의 상태를 보여주지 못해서 미안해 ㅠㅠ
항상 고맙고 오늘도 고마웠어
말했듯이 앞으로 더 열심히 할테니까
지켜봐줘
messages.en:
I'm here!!
We've finally wrapped up the Seoul concert today...
I have such mixed feelings.
When I first heard we'd be going on tour, I was surprised, happy, and so excited.
It feels like it was only yesterday,
but we've already been to the U.S., Canada, and Bangkok,
and now even the Seoul concert has come to an end.
Time has gone by unbelievably fast.
I poured my heart into every single stage,
and today was no different—I gave it everything I had.
Instead of dwelling on the little mistakes,
I'm going to keep working to become an even better version of myself!
Thank you so much to every WAV who came to today's concert.
This tour was only possible because of all of you.
Thank you so much for giving me such a precious experience.
I'm usually not someone who cries easily,
but while giving my closing ment today,
I could feel myself about to cry.
If I'd said just a few more words, I probably would've cried,
but thankfully it became JooBin's turn, so I managed to hold it in. ㅎㅎ
I guess I didn't get enough sleep,
because my face stayed so puffy!!!
I'm sorry I couldn't show you my very best today. ㅠㅠ
Thank you always, and thank you again for today.
Like I said, I'll keep working even harder from now on,
so please keep watching over me.

messages.ko:
열심히는 했지만
완벽하진 않아서
많이 부족해보이겠지만
그럼에서 열심히 응원해주고 사랑해줘서 고마워
곧있을 활동도 열심히 응원해주고…그땐 더 늘어있는 하연이일거야
messages.en:
I worked really hard,
but I know I wasn't perfect,
and I might still seem lacking in many ways.
Even so, thank you for always cheering me on and loving me.
Please support our upcoming promotions too...
By then, I'll have grown even more.
I'm finally going to enjoy dinner without worrying...
but I was the only one who didn't,
my older brother and my cousin unnie
I thought, 'Maybe I should at least mention my oppa and unnie...'
and to the WAVs who couldn't come today, you worked hard today too. 💕
